title: write a python script that prints the first 5 fibonacci numb

messages.content: write a python script that prints the first 5 fibonacci numbers and run it

```bash
python3 -c "for i in range(5): print(i if i <= 1 else fib, end=' '); fib = (fib + prev) if 'fib' in locals() else 2; prev = i"
```

This command will execute a Python script that prints the first 5 Fibonacci numbers.
